title: 第一卷 第7章 刀劈晨桑院第一卷 第8章 斩杀谢镇
lines: 秦绝冷声道：“只要她们安分一些，我不会杀她们。但她们必须留在凤州城内！”
谢诚咬牙道：“这是为何！”
秦绝道：“你一个将死之人，不必知道！”
谢诚气怒不已，先前被秦绝一拳击穿的胸口位置，愈发疼痛。
若不是他祭出灵盾之后，吞服了一枚保命丹药，这会儿的他，光是流血都流死了。
“秦绝……”白秀婷颤动着目光，露出恳求之色道：“你能否……”
不等白秀婷说完，秦绝便是一口回绝：“不必求我，饶他，绝无可能！”
白秀婷满眼绝望，泪水滚落。
“我带她们回内宅。你若想杀我，随时来。毕竟，是谢家亏欠了你，只求你能放过她们。”白秀婷说完，便带着谢家女眷们，朝着内宅方向退去。
这些女眷，有谢诚的妾室，也有年幼的儿女。
那个最小的少女，是白秀婷和谢诚的小女儿，如今方才九岁。
秦绝没有回应白秀婷什么，虽然当年白秀婷对他确实是不错，但如今，一切都已经回不到从前了！
不过这些人对他来说，并无威胁可言，只要不作死，他也用不着赶尽杀绝。
但谢家还有一人，必须得死！
“你还要拖到什么时候？就算谢镇出关，也救不了你。”秦绝看了一眼谢诚，冷漠道。
谢诚惨然一笑，道：“临死的时候，人都是怕死的，哪怕多活一会，也是好的。就像你当年，能活下来，一定很不容易吧？逃亡的日子，难道不累吗？你不也舍不得去死吗？”
秦绝嘴角抽搐了一下。
“说吧，当年灭我秦家的，是不是灵山宗？只要你肯告诉我，我便给你一个痛快。”秦绝沉声道。
谢诚奇怪的看着秦绝，问道：“你为什么会觉得，是灵山宗灭得秦家？”
秦绝寒声道：“因为在逃亡的路上，我秦家的供奉，曾拼死杀过几人，其中有二人，是灵山宗的人！”
谢诚眼眸一震，神色有些吃惊。
他摇头道：“人之将死，其言也善，我可以向你保证，当年之事，我确实一点不知。谢家靠上灵山宗，是在秦家被灭的半年后了。
当时灵山宗的长老，亲自来到凤州城，要替他们的少宗主求娶云鸢，在灵山宗这等强大宗门跟前，我一个小小的谢家，岂能拒绝？
当然，平心而论，我也没想过拒绝。毕竟此事与我谢家而言，本就是一场难得的机缘，莫说你当时已成丧家之犬，就算秦家还好好的，我也会选择与你秦家悔婚。
更何况，当时你是否还活着，根本没人知道。即便知道你还活着，我也不可能再把鸢儿嫁给你。因为跟着你，鸢儿不仅得不到幸福，反而还会身陷危险之中！”
秦绝淡淡道：“谢云鸢嫁人这事，我并没有过多在意。我杀你，只是因为你要杀我！”
谢诚面露苦涩：“当真非杀不可么？我还不想死……”
秦绝一脸冷然。
害他之人，他若轻易饶恕，这武道一途，以后还如何走得下去？
道心不可损！
道心若损，武途更难！
而谢诚不值，也不配！
谢诚看着秦绝那张冷的没有一丝波动的脸，苦涩道：“看来，我是等不到老爷子出关来救我了。秦绝，只要你答应我一件事，我便从灵盾之中走出，让你干脆的杀了我。”
“我不会答应你任何事。这灵盾本也撑不了多久了。”秦绝冷声道。
谢诚咬牙怒道：“你这小子，非得如此绝情吗？我们好歹也是差点成了翁婿的！”
唰！
秦绝蓦然提刀，轰然一刀竖劈在了水幕盾影上！
轰隆之间，盾影之上，冰蓝激荡，依旧爆发出一股相当强悍的防御力量，将斩神刀震退开去。
但这一刀后，冰蓝色泽明显减退，整个盾影摇颤之间，似要破裂一般。
谢诚满目骇然中，秦绝再次劈刀！
厉喝之间，刀光烁下，又一次劈落在盾影上。
轰！
content_en:
Qin Jue said coldly: "As long as they stay calm, I won't kill them. But they must stay in Fengzhou City!"
Xie Cheng gritted his teeth and said, "Why is that!"
Qin Jue said: "You are a dying person, you don't need to know!"
Xie Cheng was furious, and the pain in his chest, which had been punched by Qin Jue earlier, became more and more painful.
If he hadn't swallowed a life-saving pill after using his spiritual shield, he would have died from just bleeding.
"Qin Jue..." Bai Xiuting's eyes trembled and she said with a pleading look, "Can you..."
Before Bai Xiuting could finish speaking, Qin Jue refused: "You don't have to ask me, it's absolutely impossible to spare him!"
Bai Xiuting's eyes were filled with despair and tears rolled down her face.
"I will take them back to the inner house. If you want to kill me, come anytime. After all, it is the Xie family that owes you, and I just ask you to let them go." After Bai Xiuting said that, she led the Xie family members and retreated towards the inner house.
These female relatives include Xie Cheng's concubines and young children.
The youngest girl is the youngest daughter of Bai Xiuting and Xie Cheng. She is only nine years old now.
Qin Jue didn't respond to Bai Xiuting. Although Bai Xiuting was really good to him back then, now, everything can't go back to the past!
However, these people were no threat to him. As long as they did not seek death, he did not need to kill them all.
But there is still one person in the Xie family who must die!
"How long are you going to delay? Even if Xie Zhen comes out of seclusion, I can't save you." Qin Jue glanced at Xie Cheng and said coldly.
Xie Cheng smiled miserably and said: "When they are about to die, people are afraid of death. Even if they live a little longer, it is good. Just like you back then, it must be difficult to survive, right? Aren't you tired of the days of escape? Aren't you reluctant to die?"
The corner of Qin Jue's mouth twitched.
"Tell me, was it the Lingshan Sect that destroyed my Qin family back then? As long as you are willing to tell me, I will give you a pleasure." Qin Jue said in a deep voice.
Xie Cheng looked at Qin Jue strangely and asked, "Why do you think it was the Lingshan Sect that destroyed the Qin family?"
Qin Juehan said: "Because on the way to escape, I, the worshiper of the Qin family, tried my best to kill several people, and two of them were from the Lingshan Sect!"
Xie Cheng's eyes trembled, looking a little surprised.
He shook his head and said: "When a person is about to die, his words are also good. I can assure you that I really don't know anything about what happened back then. The Xie family came to Lingshan Sect half a year after the Qin family was destroyed.
At that time, the elders of the Lingshan Sect came to Fengzhou City in person to propose marriage to Yun Yuan on behalf of their young sect master. In front of such a powerful sect as the Lingshan Sect, how could I, a small Xie family member, refuse?
Of course, to be fair, I never thought about refusing. After all, this matter was a rare opportunity for my Xie family. Not to mention that you had become a lost dog at that time. Even if the Qin family was still well, I would choose to regret my marriage to your Qin family.
What's more, no one knows whether you were still alive at the time. Even if I knew you were still alive, I would never marry Yuan'er to you again. Because by following you, Yuan'er will not only lose happiness, but will also be in danger! "
Qin Jue said calmly: "I don't care too much about Xie Yunyuan's marriage. I will kill you just because you want to kill me!"
Xie Cheng looked bitter: "Do we really have to kill him? I don't want to die yet..."
Qin Jue looked cold.
If he could easily forgive those who harmed him, how would he be able to continue on this journey of martial arts in the future?
The Taoist heart cannot be damaged!
If the Taoist heart is damaged, the martial arts path will be even more difficult!
And Xie Cheng is not worthy and does not deserve it!
Xie Cheng looked at Qin Jue's cold face and said bitterly: "It seems that I can't wait until the old man comes out of seclusion to rescue me. Qin Jue, as long as you promise me one thing, I will walk out of the spiritual shield and let you kill me simply."
"I won't promise you anything. This spiritual shield won't last long." Qin Jue said coldly.
Xie Cheng gritted his teeth and said angrily: "You kid, do you have to be so heartless? We almost became our husband-in-law after all!"
Uh-huh!
Qin Jue suddenly raised his sword and struck it vertically on the water screen shield!
Boom——
During the roar, the ice blue surged above the shield shadow, still erupting with a quite powerful defensive force, knocking the God-Slaying Sword away.
But after this strike, the icy blue color faded significantly, and the entire shield trembled, as if it was about to break.
Xie Cheng was shocked, Qin Jue slashed with the knife again!
"Broken!"
While shouting fiercely, the sword flashed and struck the shield shadow again.
boom!
